forecast-period.text: A high pressure system will move over the state today. The high will then gradually drift to the southeast to be located in vicinity of Tasmania over the weekend, with a ridge expected to remain over South Australia.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible morning fog about the West Coast, Eyre Peninsula and southern parts of the North West Pastoral district. Possible morning frost about parts of the Flinders and Pastoral districts. Isolated light showers across coastal districts, more likely about windward coasts and ranges. Maximum temperatures below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, although westerly about the southeast.

Possible morning fog about the west coast and Eyre Peninsula. Possible patchy morning frost about the Flinders Ranges. Isolated light showers about the Southern Agricultural Area. Maximum temperatures below average. East to southeasterly winds, although west to southwesterly about the southeast until evening.

Possible morning fog about the the Eyre Peninsula and on and east of the ranges. Isolated light showers about the agricultural areas, with scattered showers developing in the far northwest. Maximum temperatures below average. East to southeasterly winds.

text.p: Isolated light showers about the West Coast, Eyre Peninsula and central parts of the northern pastoral districts. Maximum temperatures below average. East to southwesterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: Falls of 2 to 10 mm about the agricultural areas, possibly extending into the south of the pastorals. Isolated falls of 10 to 15 mm possible about windward facing coasts and ranges. Falls of 1 to 5 mm developing about the far northwest over the weekend.
